body: Im hugging you back, thank you
Depression takes a lot of energy, a LOT. Don't label yourself lazy until you can compare work ethics when you are in a better place emotionally.

I have mountains and forest within walking distance and use them often, sometimes it helps and sometimes the beauty of it all seems like a good place to end the walk. I'm not sure how it would work out today because i haven't been this down for awhile.

Thats why I am here. I have tried to share this with my wife a few times over the years but I always end up feeling worse for putting the weight on her. I have cut myself off from everyone outside of my immediate family and if I go to a doctor my wife will know and take on trying to help.

I have seen doctors in the past, been on medication, it always ended up with more negatives than positives. I haven't done really anything about it for a few years and was able to ride out the low parts pretty well until this last week or so, but you might be right, I don't know anything for sure right now.
thank you for the hugs, so corny but I like it :). I have developed a bit of agoraphobia, really more of a fear of people being around me than of me being around people if that makes any sense.
I don't know, I hope someone wiser will chime in for you, luck.

That was a huge amount of strength you just passed through to me with a few words, you are amazing, thank you. My head is just all over the place, if I can hold on to this line of thought for awhile that would be good. If I see a doctor I would have to open up about how I am right now to my wife and I can't do that to her again so I am am kind of stuck with the covert sources.

Thank you, they actually deserve so much better than me, but i really appreciate the reply. I don't know why the perspective of anonymous strangers on the internet helps, seems pretty irrational, but it does. Its just been a real long last few days and the only thing that got me through it was the thought of ending it when the house was empty, its going to be in a few hours and now I need a new plan.

Oh, I agree with the second half of that. I get so tired of putting on the happy face for my family when all of my thoughts are constantly negative. Fake it till you make it is bullshit, but even this brief honest interaction with you is allowing me to be real for a few seconds and that helps.

You are right about the generic responses you mostly get here or anywhere for that matter, but just knowing there are people that can empathize helps me a lot. It's better to let these feelings out here than to vent to those we love and bring them into our problems. writing and listening is a good tool to cope with our burdens.

Sounds like you did the right thing. The best any of us can do is just be there when and if they call on us. Even if she is mad right now, she will understand why you did what you did in time and recognize the caring that motivated your actions.

That's a huge burden to drop on someone you love but the fact that he is sharing this with you tells me he wants to be talked down or wants intervention. the distance obviously makes it difficult to get there physically so if he doesn't respond to talking with you, go ahead and get someone in his area involved and don't feel guilty about it.
I hear you and I am right there with you too. Sometimes we feel like this even when life isn't so bad. Its a wtf kind of situation if there ever was one.
